events.title: Open WebUI 0.12 adds versioned Skills and encrypted collaboration
events.title_zh: Open WebUI 0.12 增加版本化 Skills 与加密协作
events.summary: Open WebUI 0.12 brought versioned Skills, long-tool-chain compaction and hybrid retrieval into stable. Version 0.12.3 adds temporary end-to-end encrypted chat, lighter Redis streaming, workspace search and narrower Google Drive authorization, while fixing OAuth MCP and tool-server recovery. Preselected Skills now inject full instructions on every turn, which can materially increase prompt size.
events.summary_en: Open WebUI 0.12 brought versioned Skills, long-tool-chain compaction and hybrid retrieval into stable. Version 0.12.3 adds temporary end-to-end encrypted chat, lighter Redis streaming, workspace search and narrower Google Drive authorization, while fixing OAuth MCP and tool-server recovery. Preselected Skills now inject full instructions on every turn, which can materially increase prompt size.
events.summary_zh: Open WebUI 0.12 把版本化 Skills、长工具链压缩与混合检索带入稳定版。0.12.3 又增加临时端到端加密聊天、Redis 流式存储优化、工作区搜索和更小范围的 Google Drive 授权，并修复 OAuth MCP 恢复与工具服务故障恢复。预选 Skill 现在每轮都会注入完整指令，可能显著增加 prompt。
events.why_it_matters: For self-hosted teams, 0.12.3 changes collaboration privacy, Redis load and Skill token cost at once. Encrypted chat still requires HTTPS, WebSockets and disabled server-side WebSocket logging, so validate it in staging first.
events.why_it_matters_en: For self-hosted teams, 0.12.3 changes collaboration privacy, Redis load and Skill token cost at once. Encrypted chat still requires HTTPS, WebSockets and disabled server-side WebSocket logging, so validate it in staging first.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对自托管团队来说，0.12.3 同时改变协作隐私、Redis 负载和 Skill token 成本；加密聊天仍要求 HTTPS、WebSocket 且关闭服务端 WebSocket 日志，应先在测试环境验证。

technical_details.availability: stable GitHub release and public PyPI 0.12.0 artifacts; Tool Search remains experimental
technical_details.skills: multi-file Skills with import/export and version history
technical_details.long_runs: mid-run compaction for native tool-call chains and deferred tool loading
technical_details.retrieval: native Milvus hybrid BM25 and vector search
technical_details.security: MFA and access-control fixes; some security details are temporarily withheld
technical_details.update_0_12_3: temporary browser-side MLS encrypted chat (off by default), append-only Redis streaming keys, workspace search, Google Drive file-picker scope, OAuth MCP recovery, full selected-skill instructions each turn

technical_details_zh.可用性: GitHub stable release 与 PyPI 0.12.0 产物已公开；Tool Search 仍属实验性
technical_details_zh.Skills: 支持多文件、导入导出与版本历史
technical_details_zh.长任务: 原生工具调用链可在运行中压缩上下文，并按需加载工具
technical_details_zh.检索: 原生支持 Milvus 的 BM25 与向量混合检索
technical_details_zh.安全: 包含 MFA 与访问控制修复；部分安全细节暂未披露
technical_details_zh.时间依据: GitHub release 为 2026-10-10T21:13:24Z；PyPI 产物始于 2026-10-10T21:08:24Z
technical_details_zh.0.12.3 更新: 临时浏览器端 MLS 加密聊天（默认关闭）、Redis 追加式流存储、工作区搜索、Google Drive 文件选择权限、OAuth MCP 恢复、每轮注入所选 Skill 的完整指令

events.next_action_zh: 一天内在测试环境回归加密聊天、Redis 流、OAuth MCP 恢复，并测量附加 Skills 后的 prompt token。
events.next_action_en: In one day, regress encrypted chat, Redis streaming and OAuth MCP recovery in staging, then measure prompt tokens with attached Skills.

evidence.claim_zh: Open WebUI 0.12.0 的稳定版与 PyPI 产物已公开，发布说明列出版本化 Skills、长任务压缩、实验性 Tool Search、混合检索及访问控制修复。
evidence.claim_en: Open WebUI 0.12.0 is available as a stable release and PyPI artifact; release notes list versioned Skills, long-run compaction, experimental Tool Search, hybrid retrieval and access-control fixes.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; performance and security claims remain maintainer-reported

evidence.claim_zh: Open WebUI 0.12.3 已发布加密协作、Redis 流优化与权限修复。
evidence.claim_en: Open WebUI 0.12.3 shipped encrypted collaboration, Redis streaming improvements and permission fixes.

changes.summary_en: Open WebUI 0.12 adds versioned Skills and long-running tool controls

changes.summary_zh: Open WebUI 0.12.3 增加加密协作与 Redis 优化
changes.summary_en: Open WebUI 0.12.3 adds encrypted collaboration and Redis improvements

events.title: OpenClaw 2026.10.1 adds permission-aware Skill search and recoverable backups
events.title_zh: OpenClaw 2026.10.1 加入权限感知 Skill 搜索与可恢复备份
events.summary: OpenClaw 2026.10.1 is available on npm and GitHub with permission-aware Skill search and reading, opt-in MCP Apps, encrypted external backups and persistent Code Mode values. Search may inspect only a prefix of long instructions, MCP file editors need their own stale-save checks, and some older Workboard data needs an intermediate migration.
events.summary_en: OpenClaw 2026.10.1 is available on npm and GitHub with permission-aware Skill search and reading, opt-in MCP Apps, encrypted external backups and persistent Code Mode values. Search may inspect only a prefix of long instructions, MCP file editors need their own stale-save checks, and some older Workboard data needs an intermediate migration.
events.summary_zh: OpenClaw 2026.10.1 已在 npm 与 GitHub 发布，新增权限感知的 Skill 搜索与读取、可选 MCP Apps、加密外部备份和可跨重启保留的 Code Mode 值。搜索可能只检查长指令的前缀，MCP 文件编辑器也要自行防止陈旧保存；较旧的 Workboard 数据还需中间版本迁移。
events.why_it_matters: For teams operating local agent workspaces, discovery, permission boundaries and restoreability now share a release surface. The edge cases are operationally meaningful, so recovery and stale-write tests matter more than feature demos.
events.why_it_matters_en: For teams operating local agent workspaces, discovery, permission boundaries and restoreability now share a release surface. The edge cases are operationally meaningful, so recovery and stale-write tests matter more than feature demos.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对运行本地 agent 工作区的团队来说，发现能力、权限边界和恢复能力现在被放到同一发布面。已知边界直接影响运维，恢复演练和陈旧写入测试比功能演示更重要。

technical_details.availability: stable GitHub and npm release; public MIT package with provenance attestation
technical_details.skills: permission-aware installed-skill search/read; long instructions may be prefix-scanned
technical_details.mcp_apps: opt-in and requires compatible servers; file editors need stale-save checks
technical_details.backup: optional encrypted external or Cloudflare R2 backups restore into a fresh staging directory
technical_details.migration: older Workboard KV data may require 2026.9.7 doctor --fix first

technical_details_zh.可用性: GitHub 与 npm 稳定版已公开；MIT package 带 provenance attestation
technical_details_zh.Skills: 按权限搜索和读取已安装 Skill；长指令可能只扫描前缀
technical_details_zh.MCP Apps: 需显式启用且依赖兼容 server；文件编辑器仍需做陈旧保存检查
technical_details_zh.备份: 可选加密外部存储或 Cloudflare R2，恢复到新的 staging 目录
technical_details_zh.迁移: 旧 Workboard KV 数据可能先要用 2026.9.7 执行 doctor --fix
technical_details_zh.时间依据: npm latest 为 2026-10-10T22:45:05Z；GitHub release 为 2026-10-10T23:54:03Z

events.next_action_zh: 一天内做一次加密备份恢复，并回归权限撤销、陈旧文件保存、Skill 搜索漏检与重启后状态。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, run an encrypted restore drill and test permission revocation, stale-file saves, Skill-search misses and restart persistence.

evidence.claim_zh: OpenClaw 2026.10.1 已以稳定 GitHub/npm 版本公开，加入权限感知 Skill 搜索、可选 MCP Apps、外部备份与 Code Mode 状态持久化。
evidence.claim_en: OpenClaw 2026.10.1 is publicly available as a stable GitHub/npm release with permission-aware Skill search, opt-in MCP Apps, external backups and persistent Code Mode state.
evidence.verification: verified-primary-source; operational behavior not independently reproduced

events.title: Talorys packages a self-hosted personal agent for Cloudflare's free tier
events.title_zh: Talorys 把自托管个人 agent 打包到 Cloudflare 免费层
events.summary: Talorys packages a single-user personal agent for a user-owned Cloudflare account, combining chat, editable memory, tasks and scheduled routines on Durable Objects. A resumable installer, local mock mode, backup/import flow and automated tests are public. The HN submission drew strong attention, but there is no independent security review or production-adoption evidence.
events.summary_en: Talorys packages a single-user personal agent for a user-owned Cloudflare account, combining chat, editable memory, tasks and scheduled routines on Durable Objects. A resumable installer, local mock mode, backup/import flow and automated tests are public. The HN submission drew strong attention, but there is no independent security review or production-adoption evidence.
events.summary_zh: Talorys 把单用户个人 agent 部署到用户自己的 Cloudflare 账户，组合聊天、可编辑记忆、任务和基于 Durable Objects 的定时流程。项目公开了可续跑安装器、本地 mock、备份导入和自动测试。Hacker News 讨论热度较高，但尚无独立安全审计或生产采用证据。
events.why_it_matters: For developers who want a small self-hosted assistant, the project is a concrete, reproducible Cloudflare architecture rather than a hosted demo. Its single-user threat model, quota dependence and lack of independent review make it a trial, not a production recommendation.
events.why_it_matters_en: For developers who want a small self-hosted assistant, the project is a concrete, reproducible Cloudflare architecture rather than a hosted demo. Its single-user threat model, quota dependence and lack of independent review make it a trial, not a production recommendation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对想搭小型自托管助手的开发者来说，这是可复现的 Cloudflare 架构，不只是托管演示。但它采用单用户威胁模型，受免费额度约束，也没有独立审计，因此只适合试用。

technical_details.architecture: Cloudflare Pages, private Worker, Agents SDK Durable Object with SQLite, Workers AI and alarms
technical_details.availability: public source and npx create-talorys installer; single-user deployment into the user account
technical_details.operations: resumable install, append-only migrations, backup/import, status and doctor commands, local deterministic mock
technical_details.limits: Cloudflare quotas can change; free AI allocation is finite; no independent security review or production-adoption evidence
technical_details.time_basis: official repository was surfaced by an HN submission at 2026-10-10T10:52:09Z, before the overlap start; stored as recall-audit late discovery

technical_details_zh.运维: 可续跑安装、只追加迁移、备份导入、status/doctor 命令和确定性本地 mock
technical_details_zh.限制: Cloudflare 配额可变化，免费 AI 额度有限；没有独立安全审计或生产采用证据
technical_details_zh.时间依据: 官方仓库由 2026-10-10T10:52:09Z 的 Hacker News 提交带入召回审计，早于 overlap 起点，按 late discovery 补录

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用测试账户部署并回归权限、配额耗尽、备份恢复、重复导入和中断安装。

evidence.claim_en: Talorys publishes source, installer, backup workflow and automated tests for a Cloudflare-hosted personal agent.
